aesthetic: Warm Folio — a Swiss-editorial system anchored in warm-press paper tones, pairing grid precision with the tactile warmth of letterpress printing
chromaticArc: Opens in full warmth on Warm Paper ground (slides 1–12), punctuated by three Deep Ink section dividers at slides ~13, ~24, and ~34, with Parchment mid-tones threading through the intervals to create a light–dark oscillation that resolves back to open warmth for the closing slides.
gridStrategy: Each slide rotates through four compositional archetypes — full-bleed wide title (col 0 span 58), left sidebar with wide body (col 0–18 title / col 22–58 body), right-offset dramatic title (col 30 span 28), and centred column (col 12 span 36) — cycling with deliberate irregularity so no two consecutive slides share the same zone pattern.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on approximately 6 slides — used for pull-quote, definition, or body-heavy content slides where serif warmth counters the grid's clinical precision and reinforces the letterpress editorial identity; never on section dividers or data slides

accentStrategy: Thin 1px horizontal lines in Warm Amber bisect title-from-body zones on 40% of slides, supplemented by small 1–2 column vertical bar elements as left-margin punctuation on sidebar and offset layouts to lock the asymmetric split.
